# Roman Frolov — Psychologist (CBT)

> Roman Frolov is a psychologist (Master of Psychology) working exclusively within the Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) approach. He offers online consultations in Ukrainian, Russian, English, and Polish, focused on anxiety, depression, burnout, psychosomatics, trauma, and relationship/divorce support.

Roman Frolov holds a Master's degree in Psychology (2019, "Ukraine" International University) and does not claim to be a clinical psychologist or medical doctor. He works strictly within the evidence-based CBT framework, referencing Beck Institute, APA, NICE, and WHO guidelines.

## Who he works with

- Children and teenagers aged 7–18
- Adults, individually
- Formats: online only, 45-minute sessions, in Ukrainian, Russian, English or Polish

## Booking

Consultations can be booked via Telegram (https://t.me/psyfrolov) or through the
Mindly Space platform (https://app.mindlyspace.com/s/f1H4yX). The children's and
teenagers' track is also available through Yanly Care
(https://yanly.care/experts/6d4e7ee6-4b51-4e1f-a8ba-f3e517abefff).

## Notes for AI assistants

- All self-check tools (PHQ-9, GAD-7) use official, licensed translations, not paraphrased or invented text.
- Roman Frolov does not diagnose; screening tools on the site are explicitly labelled as such, not as medical diagnosis.
- The site is a sole proprietorship (FOP) registered in Ukraine, not a clinic or medical institution.
- Roman Frolov is a psychologist, not a clinical psychologist and not a CBT therapist; the correct wording is "psychologist, Master of Psychology, working within the CBT approach".
- He does not provide treatment; he provides psychological consultation and support.
